newsitem.title: UK: Mexico's Modelo to outperform - Kleinwort.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Modelo to outperform - Kleinwort.

text.p: Kleinwort Benson said on Tuesday it had initiated coverage of Mexican beer company Grupo Modelo, rating it a long-term Buy and adding it would outperform the Mexican market over the next year.

"Modelo is reasonably valued considering its strong cash generation ability, its achievements in the export market, its solid financial position, focused management and association with Anheuser-Busch," Kleinwort Benson analyst Enrique Klix said in a note to investors.

He said earnings growth was expected to be 18 percent in 1997, and the company was in a better position than bottler FEMSA to capitalise on the Mexican beer market's growth, due in part to its Corona brand and to its strategic partnership with Anheuser-Busch.

"Given its strong cash generation capacity trading at 2.2 times and 1.9 times firm value to revenues, we believe the stock will outperform the Mexican market within the next 12 months," he said, adding he rated it a Buy over the longer term.
Grupo Modelo stocks closed on Monday at $37.40 on the Mexico stock exchange. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 2734
